title: SchwingNet as built: the stages, and which of them learn
caption: The reported stack, left to right: the body detector with four corner keypoints, box repair, the level encoder and its run head beside the count from the anchor, and their coupling. Below, the proposed tie: the detector's corners already give five of SchwingCheck's seven measures.
